title: A Journey Of Empowerment
subtitle: NFSC Fellowship Amounting To A Total Of ₹ 20 Lakh Enables A Scholar From Coochbehar, West Bengal To Complete Her Ph.D
body_text: For students aspiring to pursue higher education and research, financial support plays a vital role in overcoming barriers and realising academic goals. For Ms. Riya Das (name changed) , a resident of Coochbehar, West Bengal, the National Fellowship for Scheduled Caste Students (NFSC) Scheme provided support to pursue doctoral studies and work towards her academic aspirations. With a determination to complete her Ph.D., achieve academic success and contribute to society through education, Ms. Riya Das sought to overcome the financial constraints that affected her higher education journey. Economic hardship and limited resources, alongside her family’s financial instability, posed challenges in managing the expenses associated with research and doctoral studies. The National Fellowship for Scheduled Caste Students (NFSC) Scheme, implemented by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, supports eligible scholars in pursuing higher education and research by providing financial assistance during their academic journey. Under the NFSC Scheme, Ms. Riya Das began receiving fellowship assistance in April 2017. The support included Fellowship, House Rent Allowance (HRA) and Contingency assistance, amounting to a total of ₹20 lakh. This assistance helped address education and research-related expenses and eased the financial stress that could otherwise affect her doctoral studies. The fellowship enabled her to focus more closely on her research and academic commitments, supporting her efforts to pursue her Ph.D. and work towards her long-term educational goals. With perseverance and the support extended under the NFSC Scheme, Ms. Riya Das successfully completed her Ph.D. Her achievement marks a significant milestone in her academic journey and reflects the role of financial assistance in enabling scholars to pursue higher education and research. Her journey highlights how access to sustained educational support can help address economic barriers, expand opportunities for academic advancement and empower scholars to realise their potential. The NFSC Scheme continues to facilitate higher education and research among eligible students, contributing to educational empowerment and inclusive development. **** SS-197-TAR/KV/GA/RK Date: 27.11.2026
